title: GrafanaCatalogEntry
description:
REAP-owned mapping from a templateKey to a Grafana dashboard/panel reference (so reap-ui can embed Grafana without hardcoding dash/panel IDs).

Security note: tenancy is never driven by Grafana URL vars. `org_id` is derived from REAP identity (JWT/embed token) and enforced by api-server/metrics-gateway. Grafana URL vars are used only for non-tenant selectors (site/target/etc.) and time range.

templateKey.description: Stable key used by dashboards templates/recommendations (e.g., `site.telemetry.interface_util_topk`).

dashUid.description: Grafana dashboard UID used in embed URLs.

panelId.description: Grafana panel ID inside the dashboard (used for solo-panel embeds).

mode.description: How to embed the Grafana content.

vars.description:
Allowed/expected Grafana template variables for this panel. REAP will set these via URL query params like `var-<name>=...` (e.g., `var-site_id`, `var-target_id`).

This list is an allowlist for what REAP will ever place into the iframe URL. It MUST NOT contain tenant identifiers such as `org_id`.

timeVars.description: Supported time bindings REAP may include in embed URLs. Typically `from`/`to` for the time range and optionally `asOf` for a snapshot cursor (if used).
